spec.mechanism: Leveraged longs pay shorts funding; a spot-long / perp-short holder collects it without predicting price. It should persist while leveraged-long demand exceeds supply and decay as the trade crowds.
spec.universe: 39 coins that passed Rule B in carry_coverage_detail.py; 1000SHIBUSDT excluded (different contract size).
spec.window_start: each coin is eligible from its first settlement hour with spot, perp, mark and funding all present (Rule B)

global_cutoff.rule: only data strictly before the cutoff is used; the cutoff is fixed from timestamps only and never moves for any coin
global_cutoff.coverage_reporting: per coin, report the first and last valid observation actually used and any gaps; a coin with data ending before the cutoff is reported as such, not extended and not allowed to shorten the window

disclosures: funding used as a direction signal in an earlier replay on 14 coins
dataset hashes recorded at the real run

portfolio_accounting.capital: 100 units of total portfolio capital at the first rebalance; this is total capital, not per coin
portfolio_accounting.allocation: on the first 00:00 UTC of each month (the monthly rebalance), total equity at that moment is split equally across coins eligible that day; each coin's slice is 50% spot long and 50% perp margin, equal notional (1x)
portfolio_accounting.new_coins: a coin that becomes eligible mid-month is not added until the next monthly rebalance. A coin eligible before the portfolio's first rebalance enters at that rebalance. There is no mid-month entry. Each coin's entry date and days waited are reported.
portfolio_accounting.coin_data_ends: if a coin's data ends or it is delisted before the cutoff, its position is closed at the last valid price with full costs; the proceeds stay in cash until the next monthly rebalance, then are redistributed equally
portfolio_accounting.liquidation: the perp leg is closed per the liquidation model; the spot leg stays open; the slice stays with that coin during the 7-day wait and is not redistributed mid-month; the coin rejoins at the next monthly rebalance if still eligible
portfolio_accounting.idle_cash: earns 0, not H. The output must report the average idle share of equity
portfolio_accounting.equity_curve: a single portfolio equity curve (all slices plus cash), daily at 00:00 UTC. Every weekly, monthly, drawdown, annual and rolling-window figure is computed from it. Daily return = change in total equity / previous day's equity. Per-coin figures use each coin's own slice-equity curve.

spec.benchmark: H is a descriptive comparison only: annualized net return of the whole portfolio equity curve, idle cash included, against H_annual. No H is credited to any position or to idle cash.
spec.funding: sum of actual settled records at their own timestamps (rate x perp qty x mark-candle open at the settlement hour); never records x 8h; received only if entry < settlement < exit
spec.rebalance: first 00:00 UTC of each month; restore equal notional and the 50/50 split inside each slice; costs on traded notional; no drift-triggered rebalance; no mid-month entry (see portfolio_accounting.new_coins)
spec.price_pnl: spot and perp marked on hourly closes; missing spot hour 2023-03-24 13:00 uses the last price, count logged, sensitivity run without that day

liquidation.status: PLACEHOLDER, not verified, not called conservative
liquidation.trigger: mark-candle high pushes perp margin equity (margin - unrealized loss + funding - fees) below maintenance
liquidation.close_price: the maintenance-trigger price, not the candle high
liquidation.spot_leg: stays open at market; spot gain never tops up perp margin
liquidation.reentry: after 7 days with full entry costs; no margin top-ups
liquidation.report: events and closest approach (min margin equity / maintenance) per coin

spec.liquidity_rank: median daily quote volume (close x base volume summed per UTC day) from fade.db spot, 2023-11-11 to 2026-10-08; ties alphabetical; 5 lowest excluded in a robustness run only
spec.liquidity_limitation: the ranking period ends 2026-10-08, two days before the historical cutoff, and starts 2023-11-11, after many coin windows begin; stated limitation, not a gate

definitions.positive_net_return: total return on capital after fees, slippage, funding and liquidation costs is strictly > 0, with no H credit
definitions.above_H: annualized net return strictly greater than H_annual
definitions.full_calendar_year: a calendar year is full-year if, on every day of that year inside the window, at least 80% of the eligible universe was active; the fraction per year is printed so no year is silently classified; thresholds apply to full years only; other years are labelled partial
definitions.rolling_windows: 26 consecutive weeks ending on a Sunday at 24:00 UTC, stepping one week, so windows overlap and are not independent; only windows fully inside the equity curve count; incomplete windows are excluded and their number reported; a window is positive if end equity is strictly greater than start equity; a missing day is carried at the previous equity and the count reported; share = positive windows / counted windows

supersedes.reason: v2.2 calibration failed (NO BLOCK QUALIFIES): block-bootstrap intervals were unreliable under persistent funding regimes. All inference was removed; the screen is descriptive only. Accounting rules are unchanged from v2.1 except the portfolio rules above.

spec.mandatory_wording: This describes what happened historically on seen data. It is not evidence of a long-term edge. No statistical significance is claimed.
prohibited: any claim of historical profitability or edge
outputs_descriptive_only: net yield on total portfolio capital, total and by calendar year
worst week, worst month, max drawdown on the equity curve
average idle share of equity, and each coin's entry date and days waited
liquidation events and closest approach at maintenance 1%, 2.5% and 5%
sensitivity: slippage 0.15%; without the 5 least-liquid coins; with and without 2023-03-24
share of coins with positive net return and share of rolling 26-week windows positive, as plain numbers
annualized net yield compared with H, at base and at stress slippage, descriptive only
per-coin coverage and the survivorship limitation
realised daily sd and funding persistence of the data, for the record

original_eight_criteria_mapping.original: 99.5% one-sided lower bound of annualized net return > H
mean > H at stress costs (slippage 0.15%, maintenance 5%)
original_eight_criteria_mapping.v2.3: descriptive comparison with H only, not a gate

original_eight_criteria_mapping.original: net return > 0 in every full calendar year
zero liquidation events in the base model
same result without the 5 least-liquid coins
original_eight_criteria_mapping.v2.3: robustness threshold: criteria 3 to 7 recomputed without those coins must still be met

spec.thresholds_status: not loosened; meeting them is a descriptive screen, not evidence of an edge
spec.rung2: NOT TESTED: its power gate was never computed. Logged as not tested, not as failed.
spec.real_data_rule: the screening script reads funding.db and carry_klines.db only after this spec is frozen and the script passes its synthetic accounting self-checks
